## Problem and change

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior, and any changed model assumptions or configuration defaults.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results, including any solver-dependent checks you could not run. For algorithm changes, include a regression case, feasibility verification, and matched quality/runtime comparisons where applicable.

## Reproducibility

Identify the instances, configurations, solver version, and time/thread settings used. Note documentation changes and keep published benchmark files separate from new experiment results.
